Extract the geographic bounding box of the transport network

Source: R/network_tools.R
street_network_bbox.Rd

The bounding box of the street network: the envelope of the street layer, which covers every 'OpenStreetMap' node of the ways streets were made from (it can be a little larger than the box of the edges of street_network_to_sf()).

Usage

street_network_bbox(network, output = c("polygon", "bbox", "vector"))

Arguments

network

A network built with build_network().

output

A character string specifying the desired output format. One of "polygon" (the default), "bbox", or "vector".

Value

By default (output = "polygon"), an sfc with a single POLYGON geometry. If output = "bbox", an sf bbox object. If output = "vector", a named numeric vector with xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax coordinates. All outputs are in WGS 84 (EPSG 4326). Package 'sf' is needed for the first two.

See also

Other network functions: build_network(), check_transit_availability(), find_snap(), get_gtfs_errors(), street_network_to_sf(), transit_network_to_sf()

Examples

data_path <- system.file("extdata/spo", package = "peabiru")
network <- build_network(data_path, n_threads = 2)
street_network_bbox(network, output = "vector")
#>      xmin      ymin      xmax      ymax 
#> -46.64771 -23.56534 -46.61130 -23.53711
